description: Look at this chart from Punch newspaper. It shows how the 2023 presidential election results went: Tinubu (APC)  got 8,794,726 votes   Atiku got 6,984,520 votes   Peter Obi got 6,101,533 votes   Kwankwaso got 1,496,687 votes   If you add Atiku, Obi, and Kwankwaso together, they had  over 14.5 million votes. That’s almost twice as many as Tinubu’s votes! In 2023, the opposition was divided into three different parties. Because their votes were split, Tinubu was able to win with fewer votes than what the others had combined. It was like three people fighting separately, so the one person left standing won easily. But now, things have changed a lot. Atiku, Peter Obi, and Kwankwaso have all joined the same party. They are no longer fighting against each other. This is very bad news for Tinubu and the APC in 2027. Here’s why: 1. No more splitting of votes  In 2023, the opposition votes were shared among three people.  Now, all those votes can go to just one candidate from their new party. Even if some people don’t follow, the new party will still start with a very big number  maybe 11 or 12 million votes from the beginning. 2. Tinubu needs many more votes to win Tinubu got about 8.8 million in 2023. To beat a united opposition, he will need way more people to support him this time. But many Nigerians are not happy with how things are going, prices are high, life is hard, and insecurity is still a problem. 3. One strong opponent instead of three weak ones. Before, Tinubu faced three smaller enemies. Now he will face one big, united team that has support in different parts of the country — North, South-East, and other areas. In simple terms: The 2023 election was won because the other side was divided. In 2027, that division is gone. The three big opposition leaders are now together in one party. Looking at these numbers, it will be very difficult for Tinubu and APC to win again. The chart that looked like a victory for Tinubu in 2023 now clearly shows why 2027 looks tough for him. #SPN #samuelpaulnews

description: Pada akhir Maret 2026, Kota New York bersiap untuk momen yang akan tercatat dalam sejarah. Donald Trump, Presiden AS yang sedang menjabat, menyerahkan diri kepada penegak hukum di Manhattan, tempat jaksa menuntutnya terkait penipuan keuangan dan penyalahgunaan aset. Penyerahan diri itu sama sekali tidak biasa. Beberapa lembaga—termasuk NYPD, Secret Service, U.S. Marshals, dan Petugas Pengadilan Negara Bagian New York—melakukan latihan simulasi untuk mempersiapkan diri menghadapi kerumunan yang diperkirakan akan berkumpul di luar kantor Jaksa Distrik Manhattan. Jalan-jalan dipenuhi barikade, petugas berjaga, dan helikopter melayang di atas kepala. Saat Trump tiba, suasananya tegang. Pendukung dan demonstran bentrok di luar, teriakan mereka bergema di seluruh kota. Di dalam, Trump diproses sebagai terdakwa kriminal—citra yang mengejutkan bagi seorang pria yang pernah membanggakan kerajaan dan kepresidenannya. Laporan yang saling bertentangan beredar tentang apakah foto wajahnya akan diambil, menambah drama. Penyerahan diri ini menyusul penyelidikan bertahun-tahun terhadap urusan bisnis Trump. Pada tahun 2024, pengadilan New York memutuskan bahwa Trump telah menggelembungkan nilai properti untuk mengamankan pinjaman, sebuah putusan yang membuka jalan bagi tuntutan pidana. Pada tahun 2026, kasus tersebut telah meningkat menjadi salah satu pertempuran hukum paling signifikan dalam sejarah AS, menguji batas-batas akuntabilitas presiden. Bagi banyak orang, momen itu melambangkan bentrokan antara kekuasaan dan keadilan. Penyerahan diri Trump bukan hanya tentang satu orang—tetapi tentang apakah supremasi hukum dapat meminta pertanggungjawaban bahkan orang yang paling berkuasa sekalipun. --- Fakta Penting - Tanggal: 31 Maret 2026 - Lokasi: Kantor Kejaksaan Distrik Manhattan, Kota New York - Tuduhan: Terkait dengan penipuan keuangan dan penyalahgunaan aset - Keamanan: NYPD, Dinas Rahasia, dan Marsekal AS melakukan latihan terkoordinasi - Kontroversi: Laporan yang saling bertentangan tentang apakah foto wajah Trump diambil .#donaldtrump #foryou #amerikaserikat #viral #berita

Alex Vantanka, a senior fellow at the Middle East Institute, warned of Iran becoming “overconfident,” as it did during the Iran-Iraq war. “If they overreach, then who knows? It's not just going to be another round of conflict. description: "Too many people that think they're politicians.” Polls have closed in the Georgia 14th Congressional District special election to determine who will replace former U.S. Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene in Congress. The seat has been vacant since January after Greene resigned following a months-long public dispute with President Donald Trump. Twenty-two candidates filed to run for the seat, but the number dropped to 17 candidates — 12 Republicans, three Democrats, one Libertarian, and one independent — all of whom appeared on Tuesday's ballot. Greene has declined to endorse anyone in the race. Former District Attorney Clay Fuller and retired Army Brig. Gen. Shawn Harris will advance to a runoff on April 7. Political observers say the race is being closely watched as a potential test of Trump’s influence within the Republican Party after he endorsed former district attorney Clay Fuller. Whoever ultimately wins the seat will serve out the remainder of Greene’s term and may have to run again later this year if they want to keep the seat beyond November. #georgia #election #mtg #politics

description: @PREDICTA MARKETS    “Most traders don’t realize this, but you can trade probability, not just charts. This is a prediction market, and it’s not gambling. It’s simply showing you what the crowd believes will happen, in percentages. When you see something priced at 5%, it means the market believes that event is very unlikely. That’s why the payout is high. On the other side, when probability is high, the payout is small. High payout always comes with low probability, and low payout comes with high probability. As traders, our job is not to trade emotions or opinions. Our job is to trade mispriced probability. You ask yourself one question: is the market overestimating or underestimating this outcome? For example, Pep Guardiola being fired is priced very low. That tells you the market believes it’s unlikely because of things like contract security, board trust, and current performance. The price already reflects that information. Now where this becomes powerful for traders is in short-term markets like gold and forex. Hourly and three-hour closes are perfect if you already trade key levels, sessions like London and New York, liquidity sweeps, and candle close reactions. The same skills apply here. The biggest mistake people make is chasing big payouts. Big payouts usually mean low probability, and that’s how accounts get blown. Smart traders focus on probability, timing, and risk management, not excitement. Prediction markets don’t replace trading. They improve the way you think about markets. If you understand probability and risk, this becomes another edge in your trading journey. My day-to-day role is serving as the general manager and partner at Benjamin Franklin Plumbing of Scottsdale, where I get to work with an incredible leadership team and a phenomenal group of technicians and support staff. Running a home service company every day keeps me close to what really matters in this industry: great technicians, strong leadership, and clear communication with homeowners. About five years ago, I started the Waste No Day podcast with a simple mission: Bring more sales and communication awareness to the skilled trades. Because the truth is, many plumbers, HVAC techs, electricians, and service technicians are phenomenal at the technical side of the job… but nobody ever teaches them the communication side. That’s where deals are won or lost. Since then, the mission has grown into something much bigger. We now run quarterly trades sales training boot camps around the country, an online platform, and a global community of owners, managers, technicians, CSRs, dispatchers, and equity partners. Right now there are people from 6–8 countries inside that community. What do they do? They post roleplay videos. They practice objection handling. They sharpen their HVAC tech sales skills, plumber sales systems, and contractor closing tips together. Because when communication improves, technicians finally earn what they’re worth and start closing the larger jobs they deserve. If you’re a plumber, HVAC tech, electrician, or home service contractor looking to improve your sales conversations in the home… you’re exactly who this is for.

description: My fellow Republicans, fellow patriots, fellow Americans who still believe in the promise of this great nation, We are eight months away from the most important midterm election of our lifetime—Tuesday, November 3, 2026. This isn’t just about seats in Congress. This is about whether we hold the line and keep America on the path to greatness—or watch radical left policies, runaway spending, open borders, and weakness abroad undo everything we’ve fought for. Right now, we have a Republican President in the White House, a Republican Senate, and a Republican House. Unified Republican government gave us historic tax cuts, energy independence, stronger borders, and a booming economy before. We’re delivering again—cracking down on illegal immigration, bringing jobs back, standing up to our enemies, and putting America First. But the left is fighting back hard. They’re desperate to flip the House, chip away at our Senate majority, and turn President Trump’s agenda into gridlock and chaos. Look at what’s happening: Inflation is still squeezing hardworking families. Prices for groceries, gas, and housing remain too high. The Democrats want to blame us, but we know the truth—their big-government spending sprees and green energy mandates fueled this mess. Our Republican majorities are fighting to cut wasteful spending, slash regulations, and unleash American energy so we can lower costs for everyone. Our southern border—after years of crisis—is finally seeing real enforcement. But if Democrats regain power, they’ll throw the doors open again, overwhelm our communities, strain our schools and hospitals, and reward lawlessness. We cannot let that happen. Abroad, our enemies are testing us. President Trump is projecting strength—standing with our allies, confronting threats from Iran, China, and beyond. Weak congressional majorities or a Democrat takeover would embolden them and tie the President’s hands. This election is about saving America from the socialist agenda that wants to: •  Raise your taxes to fund endless programs •  Defund law enforcement and let crime surge •  Erase our borders and flood our nation with unchecked migration •  Force extreme climate policies that kill jobs and drive up energy bills •  Weaken our military and apologize on the world stage We’ve seen what happens when Republicans stay home in midterms. History shows the party in power faces headwinds—but we have the issues on our side: economy, security, freedom. And we have the leader: President Trump, who’s proven he wins when Republicans show up united. So here’s my call to every Republican in Cincinnati, across Ohio, and throughout this country: •  Vote Republican on November 3. President Trump needs a strong Congress to finish the job—draining the swamp, rebuilding our economy, securing our future. Don’t sit this one out. Don’t assume others will carry the load. You are the difference. When Republicans unite and show up in massive numbers, we win—and America wins. This November, let’s keep America First. Let’s protect what we’ve built. description: Go Vote #govote #threethirtybusinessapp #threethirty ​⁠  . Go Vote Go Vote" is a phrase used to encourage people to participate in elections by casting their votes. It's a common slogan or call to action used in political campaigns and civic engagement efforts. The phrase emphasizes the importance of voting as a fundamental right and responsibility of citizens in a democracy. It's a way to motivate people to exercise their right to choose their leaders and influence government policies. Go Vote is a simple, powerful phrase that encourages people to participate in the democratic process by casting their ballots in elections. It's a call to action that emphasizes the importance of voting in shaping the future of a community, state, or nation. The Voting Process. Here's a general overview of the voting process in many countries: Voter Registration: Eligibility: Determine if you meet the age, residency, and citizenship requirements to vote. Registration: Complete a voter registration form, either online, by mail, or in person at a designated location. Election Day: Polling Place: Go to your assigned polling place, which is a designated location where voting takes place. Identification: Present a valid government-issued ID to verify your identity. Ballot: Receive a ballot, either paper or electronic. Voting: Cast your vote for candidates or ballot measures by marking your choices on the ballot. Submission: Submit your completed ballot to election officials. Additional Considerations: Early Voting: Many jurisdictions offer early voting options, allowing you to cast your ballot in person before Election Day. Mail-in Voting: Some states and countries allow voters to request absentee ballots and vote by mail. Voter ID Laws: Different jurisdictions have varying voter ID laws, so be aware of the specific requirements in your area. Election Integrity: Be informed about election security measures and potential misinformation. Why Vote? Voting is a fundamental right and responsibility of citizens. By voting, you: Influence Policy: Your vote helps elect representatives who make decisions that affect your life and community. Hold Leaders Accountable: Voting allows you to express your approval or disapproval of elected officials. Strengthen Democracy: Active participation in elections strengthens democratic institutions. To learn more about specific voting procedures and regulations in your area, please visit your local election office website or contact them directly.

This discussion examines how the forecast period aligned with the severe weather and widespread flooding that developed across northern and eastern Australia, including the major rainfall and river flooding that impacted parts of the Northern Territory and Queensland.   I also take a forward look at the next developing high-energy period between 15–18 March 2026, where a new sequence of atmospheric features is beginning to combine across the continent.   This pattern is expected to involve:  • Renewed frontal activity moving through southern Australia  • Interaction with northern tropical moisture returning through the interior  • The potential for follow-up rainfall across southern agricultural zones, including parts of southern Western Australia, South Australia, Victoria, Tasmania and southern New South Wales   This update provides insight into how these large scale systems evolve, how they were identified well in advance through the Oz Industries Forecasting methodology, and what regions should be monitoring as the next weather phase develops. description: COMMUNITY NOTICE FROM THE MAYOR   Merrill Ends City Leases, Public Access to Sky Valley Properties In keeping with our commitment to transparency and timely communication, the City of Sky Valley is providing immediate notice of a significant development affecting public access to several community spaces. Yesterday (April 8, 2026) the City received formal notice from Merrill Trust entities that all leases and permissions for City use of its properties will be terminated in 30 days, effective May 8, 2026. As a result of this unilateral action by the property owner, we expect access to end for the City, our residents, and the public at multiple areas maintained for years by the City of Sky Valley. These include the Mud Creek Trail, Mud Creek Falls, the Scenic Overlook on Dillard Highway, the park and walking trail opposite the Sky Valley Post Office, the old Ski Lodge and parking lot, and other associated work areas. The notice further states that, after May 8, 2026, any person entering these properties will be considered to be trespassing. These are spaces the City has actively maintained and that residents and visitors have come to value. While the City has worked in good faith to preserve access, the decision to terminate that access rests solely with the property owner. In the interests of full transparency, the letter from Merrill Trust's attorney is attached for your review. Merrill’s decision follows the City Council’s vote to rescind approximately $5 million in state and federal grants tied to a proposed septic-to-sewer project advanced by the previous administration. This Mayor and City Council made clear that any infrastructure decision of that magnitude must be driven by demonstrated need, not external pressure or development objectives. The City specifically reached out to stakeholders to invite them to participate in the work sessions held before the vote; Merrill Trust was among the entities invited. Following the City Council’s vote, I formally notified the relevant agencies that the City would not accept the grants or proceed with the project. The City is evaluating next steps after Merrill Trust’s decision. This matter will be addressed publicly at an upcoming City Council meeting, and we will continue to provide updates as information becomes available. Benita Cotton-Orr Mayor, City of Sky Valley Merrill Trust's Attorney's Letter https://skyvalleyga.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Merrill-Letter_20to_20City_20of_20Sky_20Valley.4.8.26.pdf#publicserviceannouncement #waterfall #share

description: #juliaca #puno #peru🇵🇪  #PUNO : 56 CANDIDATOS AL SENADO Y 197 A DIPUTADOS DISPUTAN REPRESENTACIÓN EN ELECCIONES 2026 La región Puno ya vive un intenso escenario político con miras a las Elecciones Generales 2026. De acuerdo con información oficial del Jurado Nacional de Elecciones (JNE), 56 candidatos al Senado por distrito múltiple y 197 candidatos a la Cámara de Diputados se encuentran actualmente en proceso de inscripción para representar a la región. Los datos provienen del análisis de 61 expedientes presentados ante el JNE, los cuales corresponden a diversas organizaciones políticas que buscan participar en la contienda electoral. Del total de partidos inscritos, cinco agrupaciones optaron por presentar únicamente candidatos a Diputados, sin incluir postulantes al Senado, lo que evidencia distintas estrategias políticas de cara al nuevo sistema bicameral. La oferta electoral en Puno refleja uno de los panoramas más competitivos de los últimos años, con una amplia variedad de partidos, liderazgos y perfiles profesionales que buscarán captar el respaldo ciudadano en las urnas. Con el objetivo de informar y facilitar el acceso a estos datos, se ha elaborado una infografía especial de cinco páginas, donde se detalla de manera ordenada: 📊El partido político participante *Los dos candidatos al Senado por cada organización *Los seis candidatos a Diputados por la región Puno Este material busca contribuir a un voto informado, permitiendo a la ciudadanía conocer quiénes aspiran a representarlos en el Congreso de la República. 📊 Información por la región Puno 🗂️ Cortesía de ANDINO.PE y la encuestadora INTI #Puno #Elecciones2026 #RegiónPuno #Senado #Diputados #JNE #PolíticaPeruana

description: UK council elections on 7 May 2026 will see over 5,000 seats contested across 136 English authorities, including all London boroughs. Polls point to a Reform UK surge: the party leads national voting intention at around 24-28%, with projections of up to 2,260 net seat gains, potentially seizing control of several county councils from the Conservatives while hammering Labour. The irony hits hard among nationalists. Nigel Farage built Reform on promises to defend native Britons against mass immigration, yet critics accuse him of selling out by parachuting numerous foreign nationals as council candidates—while cosy overtures to Tory voters blur the anti-establishment edge. Many longtime Reform supporters feel betrayed, viewing it as abandoning the very people he vowed to champion. Disillusioned nationalists are increasingly switching to Restore Britain, Rupert Lowe’s newer party. Though still embryonic, Restore shows a promising trajectory, polling around 7-10% in early surveys and rapidly building membership for the next general election.

Since taking over at the Agriculture Ministry, Kagwe has driven a fast, results-oriented agenda, pushing increased funding and aligning the sector with the Bottom-Up Economic Transformation Agenda (BETA) to boost incomes, jobs, and economic stability. His policies prioritizing local wheat, establishing animal feed reserves, and promoting climate-smart agriculture have helped stabilize markets, protect farmers, and build resilience against climate shocks. Reforms in coffee and tea sectors focusing on better pricing, value addition, and efficient marketing are also restoring farmer earnings and competitiveness. The survey places Kagwe ahead of other top performers, including Rebecca Miano and Geoffrey Ruku, cementing his position as a standout in H.E President William Samoei Ruto Cabinet. Overall, his tenure reflects a shift in positioning agriculture as a central pillar of Kenya’s economic transformation and food security. www.kenyatrack.co.ke

The country's main opposition party, Les Démocrates, has been effectively excluded from the race, raising concerns about the electoral process's credibility. description: After a lot of thought and reflection, I’ve made the decision to withdraw from the race for Michigan State Senate in District 32. I got into this race because I believe in people. I believe we need leaders who truly put people first. Not just say it, but live it every day. And that’s something I’ll always stand on. But the reality is, running a campaign across five counties takes a lot of resources. I’ve personally invested thousands of dollars into this race, and we just haven’t been able to raise what it takes to stay competitive. My opponent, Rebecca Amidon, has outraised me by over $50,000. And at the same time, I’ve got real responsibilities. I’ve got a career, bills to pay, and I just got married & I owe it to my family to continue showing up and doing my part at home too. This wasn’t an easy decision, but it’s the right one. I want to be clear though… this isn’t the end for me. Not even close. This is a learning experience. I’m going to take what I’ve learned, come back stronger, and be even more prepared for whatever comes next, whether that’s local, county, or state. I also want to say this: I’m proud to support and endorse Rebecca Aimidon for State Senate. This is a seat we need to flip, and it hasn’t been blue since 1982. So I’m asking everyone who supported me, please stay engaged and support her campaign. I’m still here. I’m still working. I still believe in this community, and I still believe we can build something better together. And to everyone who supported me on this journey, THANK YOU. It truly means more than you know. Make sure to vote, & Remember… you make the difference.  #youmakethedifference  #TheCommunityAgent  #Jaykilgo

description: Polls#fyp

What exactly is a poll tax and does the SAVE Act really qualify as one? In this video, we break down the real history of poll taxes in the United States and explain why the comparison matters. From Jim Crow era voting laws to the passage of the 24th Amendment in 1964, this story traces how poll taxes were used as a direct government fee to block citizens from voting and why that practice was ruled unconstitutional. Understanding the original purpose of poll taxes is essential to evaluating modern election debates accurately. We also examine the SAVE Act, voter ID laws, and citizenship verification requirements through a historical and constitutional lens. This video explains the difference between government imposed voting taxes and eligibility verification rules, addresses arguments about ID costs, and explores how courts have historically treated incidental expenses versus state mandated fees. If you are interested in voting rights history, election law, the 24th Amendment, voter ID debates, or how historical definitions shape modern political arguments, this video provides clear context grounded in documented history. #saveact #history #historytok #polltax #voterid

description: Talk of another impeachment battle is beginning to grow in Washington, even though neither President Trump nor Vice President JD Vance is currently facing formal impeachment proceedings. As the 2026 midterm elections approach, the issue has become an increasingly visible political fight. A January survey found that 49% of likely voters support impeaching Trump, while 45% oppose it, with Democrats strongly in favor, Republicans mostly against it, and independents nearly split down the middle. Several impeachment resolutions have already been introduced in the House. One of the most recent, H. Res. 939, was filed in December 2025. But the effort stalled almost immediately when the House voted 237-140 to table the measure, preventing it from moving forward. Prediction markets currently put the chances of Trump being impeached before early 2027 at around 14%, but those odds rise sharply to roughly 70% by January 2028. Many political analysts say the 2026 midterms could decide whether impeachment becomes a real possibility, especially if Democrats regain control of the House. Trump has also warned supporters that if Republicans lose Congress, another impeachment fight could follow.

La queue de cerise, l’ortie et le chardon-marie sont trois plantes traditionnellement utilisées pour soutenir le drainage, favoriser l’élimination et contribuer au confort articulaire. Une routine naturelle appréciée dans les périodes où l’organisme a besoin d’être détoxifié et régulé. 📌 Posologie  (À adapter selon les dosages indiqués sur le produit utilisé) 	•	Queue de cerise : infusion ou gélules, 2 à 3 fois par jour. 	•	Ortie : infusion ou gélules, 1 à 2 fois par jour. 	•	Chardon-marie : gélules ou extrait, 1 à 2 fois par jour, de préférence avec un repas. /!\ Boire suffisamment d’eau tout au long de la journée pour soutenir l’effet drainant. ⚠️ Contre-indications & précautions 	•	Queue de cerise : prudence si traitement diurétique ou troubles rénaux → avis médical recommandé. 	•	Ortie : déconseillée en cas de rétention hydrosodée, d’insuffisance cardiaque ou rénale sans avis médical. 	•	Chardon-marie : éviter en cas d’allergie aux plantes de la famille des astéracées. 	•	Déconseillé aux femmes enceintes ou allaitantes sans avis professionnel. 	•	Si vous suivez un traitement médical (goutte, tension, reins, diabète…), demander conseil à un professionnel de santé avant utilisation. 	•	Ne remplace pas un traitement médical. #goutte#acideurique#plantesmedicinales

description: Are Gas Stations Ripping You Off? Most people assume that when they pay for 1 liter of gasoline, they get exactly 1 liter—but that’s not always the case. Fuel pumps are supposed to be calibrated and checked by government agencies, but there's actually a legal margin of error, usually around ±0.5%. That means you could be getting slightly less fuel than what you're paying for, and it’s still considered legal. Over time, wear and tear can cause pumps to drift further out of accuracy, especially if they’re not regularly calibrated. If you notice that your fuel seems to run out faster than usual, it's not just in your head. You can report it to your local Weights and Measures Inspector, who’s responsible for checking pump accuracy and protecting consumers. description: Polls (or any surveys) can vary a lot depending on how they're run. A lot of charts will hide the margins of error - a range within which the true value is expected to fall based on the sample sizes. While this is a good first step, a web of other biases can impact how accurate these polls really are. Sampling bias can leave certain groups are left out, while interview bias influences responses through subtle cues from the interviewer. Question framing can lead answers in a particular direction, and response bias occurs when people answer based on what they think sounds best, not what they truly believe. Always look beyond a single poll! By examining an aggregate of polls, patterns emerge, revealing a more trustworthy view of public opinion than any single survey alone. All data shown in the video is sample data and does not resemble any real life events. #Polls #Election #Politics #Survey #Charts #Viz #Graph #Vizualization #Education #Data #Nyt #Misleading #Ballots #Vote #FiveThirtyEight #Statistics

description: Benner's Cycle vs Reality 1870-2026 Can a 19th-century farmer's prediction explain 150+ years of market crashes and booms? In 1872, Ohio farmer Samuel Benner published a chart predicting economic cycles from 1780 to 2059 — based on pig iron, corn, and hog prices. We overlay his predictions against 10 real economic indicators to see how well they match.   📊 WHAT THIS METRIC MEANS All indicators are rebased to 100 at their first available data point so they can be compared on the same chart regardless of nominal value. A value of 200x means the indicator doubled; 1,000x means it grew 10-fold. The Benner Cycle line is a synthetic wave constructed from Benner's original predicted Panic Years, Good Times, and Hard Times dates. When the Benner wave peaks = predicted boom; when it dips = predicted crash. The Y-axis uses a logarithmic scale.   📂 DATA SOURCES • S&P 500: Robert Shiller IE dataset (1871-2026) • Dow Jones: S&P Dow Jones Indices / Measuring Worth (1896-2026) • US GDP: Bureau of Economic Analysis / Maddison Project (1870-2026) • Gold: World Gold Council / LBMA (1870-2026) • Crude Oil: BP Statistical Review / EIA (1870-2026) • Copper: USGS / World Bank Pink Sheet (1870-2026) • Corn: USDA / World Bank (1870-2026) • US CPI: Bureau of Labor Statistics (1870-2026) • Iron & Steel: USGS / American Iron & Steel Institute (1870-2026) • Industrial Production: Federal Reserve Board (1919-2026) • Benner's Cycle: Reconstructed from Samuel Benner's original 1884 chart   🔢 HOW IT'S CALCULATED Each indicator uses its annual average value in USD or index level. The index formula is: (current_value ÷ base_value) × 100, where base_value is the value in the first available year. The Benner Cycle wave is constructed using cosine interpolation between Benner's predicted Panic Years (troughs) and Good Times Years (peaks), with a 3.5% annual growth trend to keep it visible on the logarithmic scale alongside growing metrics.   📊 BENNER'S CYCLE KEY DATES Panic Years (predicted crashes): 1873, 1891, 1911, 1929, 1949, 1965, 1981, 1999, 2019 Good Times (predicted peaks): 1881, 1899, 1919, 1937, 1953, 1973, 1989, 2007, 2025 Hard Times (predicted bottoms): 1877, 1897, 1913, 1932, 1951, 1969, 1985, 2003, 2021   🌍 INDICATOR COVERAGE 10 real-world indicators selected to represent: stock markets (S&P 500, Dow Jones), economic output (US GDP, Industrial Production), commodities Benner originally studied (Corn, Iron & Steel), key commodities (Gold, Crude Oil, Copper), and price levels (CPI). All US-focused to match Benner's original American market analysis.   ⚠️ NOTE Benner's Cycle is a historical curiosity, not proven financial theory. Correlation does not imply causation. Some alignments may be coincidental. 2025-2026 data includes estimates. Gold was at a fixed price ($20.67/oz) from 1870-1933, then $35/oz until 1971 under Bretton Woods — its line is flat during those periods. This is a data visualization, not financial advice.   #bennerscycle #stockmarket #sp500 #dowjones #gold #oil #commodities #economics #marketcycles #financialhistory

description: A new Ipsos poll for Global News suggests Prime Minister Mark Carney’s Liberals are entering the upcoming byelections with both momentum — and growing public support for a majority government. What the poll found👉 🔹53% of Canadians say they want the Liberals to win enough seats in Monday’s byelections to form a majority government. 🔹47% say they are opposed to that idea. 🔹Among NDP voters, 56% also said they would prefer the Liberals to gain enough seats for a majority. If a federal election were held tomorrow, the poll found: 🔹Liberals: 45% support 🔹Conservatives: 33% support 🔹NDP: 9% 🔹Bloc Québécois: 7% nationally and 29% in Quebec 🔹Greens: 2% 🔹People’s Party: 2% The poll points to softening Conservative support across multiple groups: 🔹Among 18-to-35-year-olds, 29% now say they would vote Liberal, compared with 22% for the Conservatives. 🔹Men and women are now equally likely to support the Liberals, at around 45% each. 🔹Ipsos CEO Darrell Bricker said: “Those double digits are coming from somewhere.” 🔹He added of Conservative leader Pierre Poilievre: “[Poilievre] is losing across the demographic perspective.” Why the byelections matter👉 The article notes that two of the three Monday byelections are in Toronto-area ridings considered safe Liberal seats, making it increasingly likely the party could cross the 172-seat threshold needed for a majority in the House of Commons. About the poll👉 The Ipsos survey was conducted April 2 to 7, 2026, on behalf of Global News. It surveyed 1,000 Canadians aged 18 and older online, using quotas and weighting to reflect the Canadian population. Ipsos says the precision of its online polling is measured using a credibility interval. Source: Global News 🇨🇦 #MarkCarney #Liberals #Byelections #IpsosPoll #canada

description: The 2024 presidential election polls showed some improvement over previous years, however still had their fair share of misses. On the positive side, national polls were more accurate than in recent elections, correctly predicting key demographic shifts ahead of the presidential race. However, there were some notable errors. Polls slightly overstated support for Kamala Harris & understated it for Donald Trump. For instance, the final national NBC News poll had Trump & Harris tied at 49% each, while the actual result showed Trump leading Harris nationally by 2 percentage points: 50% to 48%. Additionally, battleground state polls had larger misses than national polls, highlighting the challenges of polling in specific regions. Despite these imperfections, polls are getting better, & it's essential to remember that they're just predictions, not precise measurements. By acknowledging both the strengths & weaknesses of polling, we can stay informed & engaged in the democratic process. #Election2024 #PollingAccuracy #USPolitics #ElectionAnalysis #PollingImprovement #DemocracyInAction #ElectionIntegrity #VotingMatters #ElectionResults2024
